builtInBehaviors.description: Modal dialogs move initial focus inside the popup, keep Tab traversal contained while open, and restore focus to the opening trigger when dismissed.
Rendering Dialog.Title automatically names the dialog popup via aria-labelledby, and Dialog.Subtitle or Dialog.Description wires its accessible description.
Pressing Escape inside an open Dialog closes an open inner menu or hovered tooltip first before dismissing the Dialog itself.

defaultBehaviors.description: Closing the dialog returns focus to the element that triggered it unless overridden with finalFocus.

usageGuidelines.description: Include Dialog.Title inside Dialog.Header or Dialog.Content (or pass aria-label on Dialog.Content) so screen readers announce the dialog's purpose.
Wrap Cancel actions with Dialog.Close render={<Button>Cancel</Button>} or include Dialog.CloseButton so keyboard and pointer users have a clear dismissal control.
Place plain text directly in Dialog.Header without wrapping the heading in Dialog.Title; Dialog.Header is a layout container and does not name the dialog.
